content:
opsbot: Incident detected: high alert delivery latency from PagerDuty integration (rule: infra-500s-errors). Auto-create incident: INC-20260315-01

maya: seeing this too — missed 2 pages while I was oncall. pd web shows ‘delivered’ but phone didn’t ring. anyone else?

alex: same here. PD UI shows alerts stuck in ‘routing’ for ~30s then finally delivered.

kevin: our observability vendor (metrics-collector) had a partial outage around the same time. PD uses webhooks -> our webhook relay. maybe retries/backpressure?

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: "Alert routing delays detected". Status: acknowledged by opsbot. https://status.pagerduty.com/ :rotating_light:

elena: customer-facing impact likely minimal so far, but some oncall missed critical pages. sophie, can you check support queue for any high-priority tickets?

sophie: I'm paged in. looking at support queue now. one customer (acct: zeta-inc) has ticket about delayed response on live inference. marking P2 for now.

maya: quick mitigation: can we enable SMS fallback for current rotation and trigger a manual PD alert to validate?

alex: +1 enable SMS fallback. also temporarily widen escalation policy to include the secondary pager (kevin).

kevin: done — added SMS fallback and added my contact to the escalation. testing with a test alert now.

kevin: sending test alert:
```
curl -X POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{ "routing_key": "REDACTED", "payload": { "summary": "PD test alert — routing fallback", "source": "infra.selftest", "severity": "info" } }'
```

maya: I got the SMS within 12s but no phone ring. alex, did you get the SMS?

alex: got SMS and web notification. didn't get phone either. phone provider might be throttling from PD side.

elena: I just confirmed with monitoring: the webhook queue between PD and our relay spiked and then retried. the retry pileup explains the bursts and some items timing out.

opsbot: PagerDuty has posted a partial incident: "Investigating delayed notifications for customers in NA region". link: https://status.pagerduty.com/incidents/xyz123

maya: contacting PagerDuty support on the incident channel now. @pagerduty-bot we need ETA and contact.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty support ticket created: PD-78945. Assigned to L2. Initial ETA 30-60m.

kevin: while PD sorts it out, we should: 1) alert customers on status.redwood.com, 2) switch critical alerting to alternate channel (ops-sms direct), 3) set up manual phone call list for current oncall.

sophie: drafting status update for status.redwood.com. will mention "intermittent notification delays" and that we are mitigating with SMS and manual calls.

alex: configuring failover: publish an event into our ops-sms gateway for any PD delivery failure. small script:
```
# pseudocode
if pd_delivery_delay > 20s:
  send_sms(ops_oncall_list, msg)
```

elena: I pushed a short-lived fallback that watches webhook ack latency and fires our internal SMS gateway. rolling it to prod now.

maya: good. also make sure runbooks updated — link to inc runbook: /runbooks/pagerduty-fallback.md (added steps for manual call list).

kevin: FYI PagerDuty posted that they are seeing API gateway congestion due to third-party provider (telephony vendor) — they are rerouting.

pagerduty-bot: PD update: "We are rerouting notifications to alternative carrier. Some customers may experience duplicate notifications as we retry."

maya: duplicate notifications are fine compared to missing pages. keep retries.

sophie: status page draft posted: "We are aware of notification delays affecting some alert delivery. Mitigations include SMS fallback and manual oncall outreach. No customer data impacted." posted at https://status.redwood.com/incident/pd-delays-20260315

elena: Support note: zeta-inc incident updated — they were impacted for ~8 minutes during the spike. queued for follow-up by support.

maya: handoff plan: I'm oncall for another 45m, then alex takes primary. leaving a short note in PD with mitigations done and that PD ticket PD-78945 is open.

alex: will take over. please include checklist: enable SMS fallback (done), add kevin to escalation (done), manual call list (doc link: /ops/manual-calls.md), status page link.

opsbot: Automatic note: INCIDENT INC-20260315-01 will have an initial severity set to Sev2. Postmortem owner: clara_tbd.

kevin: PD support just replied: they expect full resolution in ~45m, and they recommend customers set up alternate contact methods for high-severity alerts while carrier migration completes.

maya: ok, let's keep monitoring. set a recurring check-in every 10m in this thread. next check in in 10m.

(10 minutes later)

elena: PD says reroute is complete, delivery times trending back to normal. SLOs for alert delivery restored. still seeing a few late deliveries but much lower.

pagerduty-bot: PD update: Incident resolved. Root cause: telephony carrier congestion affecting NA notifications. Resolution: rerouted to alternate carriers.

sophie: support queue cleared for related tickets, all affected customers contacted. adding follow-up tasks to customer-success board.

maya: thanks team. creating a post-incident task list: 1) postmortem (owner: clara), 2) add permanent SMS fallback option in runbooks, 3) review PD escalation config and timeouts, 4) customer follow-ups.

alex: logging follow-ups in retro board and tagging infra+oncall.

maya: handing off to alex now. please pick up monitoring/checks.

alex: taking over. will schedule the postmortem and sync with PagerDuty PM if needed.

(End of thread)
